candidate_change: Any candidate or feature/recipe expansion invalidates the planned pre-holdout protocol and requires a new explicit freeze.
contract: Before decoder or file read: sealed real data require explicit safe metadata columns; outcome/features require positively bounded permitted-season predicates. Unknown/broad requests fail closed. No final-holdout access. Whole-file checksums may stream opaque bytes but never return/decode them. No generic force override.
historical: Preserve all historical evidence unchanged. Archive fit/evaluation tests outside ordinary discovery; no historical sealed-data reproduction command is authorized.
implementation_addendum: Mixed outcome containers are metadata-only even with row filters. load_outcomes reads explicit columns from separate open-season files to avoid decoding sealed row groups. Anonymous decoders rejected. Normal discovery excludes historical fit/evaluation tests; guarded model entry points and sklearn fit/predict are disabled. Opaque checksums permitted, never decoded.
normal_execution: Network blocked; model fitting/replay/evaluation excluded from Stage 4A. Synthetic structural fixture arithmetic is permitted.
startup: Project virtualenv .pth activates policy before code execution; package import and first discovery module also activate it.
